question: Could you list each musical style with the number of times it appears as a 1st, 2nd, or 3rd preference in a single row per style?
sql: SELECT ms.StyleName, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM musical_preferences mp JOIN musical_styles ms ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID GROUP BY ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName ORDER BY ms.StyleName
